Edwards Roofing and Construction was built on a simple promise: deliver dependable craftsmanship and treat every customer with honesty and respect. Founded by Cory Edwards in September 2024, the company grew from a lifetime of experience—over 20 years working in roofing, construction, and property improvement throughout Central Louisiana. After decades of perfecting his skills and understanding what homeowners truly need, Cory set out to create a company that puts quality and integrity first.

Starting with a small team and a big vision, Edwards Roofing and Construction quickly earned trust within the community by showing up on time, communicating clearly, and delivering results that last. Whether repairing storm damage or installing a brand-new roof, the focus has always remained the same: protect families, strengthen homes, and serve the region with pride.

Today, our story continues with every project we complete—and every homeowner who chooses us.
